title: Boutique: platform overview

panels.title: SLIs: is the shop healthy? (dev and prod)
Availability prod (non-5xx %)
panels.description: Share of requests to the prod ALB that did not end in a 5xx from the shop. SLO: 99.5%.

panels.title: Availability dev (non-5xx %)
panels.description: Share of requests to the dev ALB that did not end in a 5xx from the shop. SLO: 99.5%.

panels.title: p95 latency prod
panels.description: 95% of requests to the prod shop were answered faster than this (ALB TargetResponseTime). SLO: 1 s.

panels.title: p95 latency dev
panels.description: 95% of requests to the dev shop were answered faster than this (ALB TargetResponseTime). SLO: 1 s.

panels.title: Order success rate prod (1 h)
panels.description: Orders whose stock was reserved, out of all orders inventoryservice decided on (FAILED = out of stock). Duplicates are not counted.

panels.title: Order success rate dev (1 h)
panels.description: Orders whose stock was reserved, out of all orders inventoryservice decided on (FAILED = out of stock). Duplicates are not counted.

panels.title: Pods not ready prod
panels.description: Running pods that fail their readiness probe. Should be 0.

panels.title: Pods not ready dev
panels.description: Running pods that fail their readiness probe. Should be 0.

panels.title: 5xx errors per minute
panels.description: Target 5xx = the shop answered an error. ALB 5xx = no healthy pod could answer.

panels.title: Catalog cache hit rate
panels.description: Catalog requests answered from Redis instead of MySQL (productcatalogservice).

panels.title: Catalog: MySQL loads and errors (per 5 min)
panels.description: A MySQL load happens once per cache expiry (5 min). Errors and fallbacks should stay at 0.

panels.title: Orders decided by inventoryservice (per 5 min)
panels.description: reserved = confirmed order, failed = out of stock, duplicate = an event delivered twice (handled once).

panels.title: Inventory: event processing time p95
panels.description: Time inventoryservice needs to reserve stock for one OrderCreated event.

panels.title: Inventory: message errors (per 5 min)
panels.description: invalid = rejected event (goes to the DLQ after 3 tries), processing = AWS error (retried).

panels.title: Messages waiting per queue
panels.description: A queue that stays above 0 means its consumer is slow or stopped (alarm: <queue>-backlog).

panels.title: Dead-letter queues
panels.description: Messages that failed 3 times. Anything above 0 raises an alarm in #boutique-alerts.

panels.title: Container restarts (per hour)
panels.description: Restarts in the last hour. A pod that keeps restarting is crash-looping (see the runbook).
